lines.t: When I think of him
Of all he's done
Of all he's made and how he created us, of how he loves us so, I just want to abide in him, to always obey and walk in his ways.
And I can't help but wonder
That when you hear His words
How can you not want to obey Him?
I will always follow Him
Do what He says to do
And I can't help but wonder
How can you not too?
How can you not love him?
How can you not see?
How can you not feel him in everything?
Why can you obey me?
I don't want to listen to let every syllable be heard.
I just want to always walk in his ways.
To read his words.
To pay him all my days.
And I can't help but wonder
How could you possibly know?
I wanna always listen
With open ears
When I hear his words
My heart tears
And I am always watching and long for the day when he gathers up and takes me away.
My heart burns with passion when I hear his name.
And I can't help but wonder
How can yours not too?
Oh, how can you not love him?
How can you not see?
How can you not feel him in everything?
Why can you remain in doubt to his words?
And I don't want to listen to let every syllable be heard
I just want to always walk in His ways
To read His words
To obey Him all my days
And I can't help but wonder
How could you possibly not?
How can you not want to abide in Him?
How can you not want to hear His words?
How can you know
How I want to for all my days
Obey Him in every way
To always feel His love
And I cherish every blessing from above
I love Him
And I can't help but wonder
How can you not?
Thank you.
